title: Socket events
description: Every WebSocket frame, in both directions, is an Envelope. x-variants maps each type to the definition its data must match and the direction it travels: s2c is pod to client, c2s is client to pod, local is daemon to TUI over the unix socket only. The TUI talks to the daemon with this same envelope.
x-rules: seq and ts are set on s2c frames only. A c2s frame that carries either is refused.
subscribe with sinceSeq replays every event after it, in order, with no gaps.

run.stop is sent only to the computer that hosts the run, when a person stops it. The pod has already revoked the run token, so the daemon cancelling late changes nothing. An un-acked run.stop is re-sent on every heartbeat from that computer until the daemon reports the run ended (POST /v1/runs/:run/end), the same pattern as run.wake. run.stop is s2c only.
run.wake is sent only to the computer that hosts the agent. Wakes for one agent coalesce: one pending wake means one turn. An un-acked wake is re-sent on the next heartbeat after 60 s.
Every claim that ends emits exactly one claim.released, sent to every pod member, whatever the cause. task.updated still fires as before; claim.released is the who and why.
claim.released carries by (the Actor who released or stopped the claim) when cause is released or stopped, and no by otherwise. reason is present only when the caller gave one.
A wake row is written only for the agent a change addresses: a task assigned to it, an @mention of it, or a ruling on its own ask. Ambient messages write none.

RunToolCall.description: The daemon reports one harness tool call it saw on a run it hosts (computer token only). The pod assigns the id and stores a ToolCallRecord with source daemon. The agent never sends this.

name.description: The tool's name as the harness reports it.

digest.description: The start of the call's input and output, cut to 600 characters.

EventType.description: Every kind of socket frame. x-variants gives each one its direction and its data.

Envelope.description: The frame every socket message is sent in.

seq.description: The pod's event number. Set on pod-to-client frames only; a client-to-pod frame that carries it is refused.

ts.description: The frame's timestamp. Set on pod-to-client frames only; a client-to-pod frame that carries it is refused.

data.description: The event's payload. Its fields come from the definition x-variants names for type, and that definition accepts only its listed fields.

Member.description: A member of a pod and the role they hold.

PresenceState.description: Whether a member is online, offline or working.

AgentPresence.description: An agent's presence: its harness, the computer it runs on and its state.

Hello.description: What the pod tells a client about itself and the client: head sequence, the client's actor, members and agents.

agents.description: The pod's agents and their presence.

MessageUpdated.description: Only a decision changes after a message is created. The summary never changes.

TaskClaimed.description: A task was claimed: who holds it, on which run, and until when. The lease renews while its run is alive (any operation on the run token, or the hosting daemon's heartbeat); see ADR 0002.

ClaimReleaseCause.description: Why a claim ended: expired (lease ran out), released (task_release), run_ended (the run ended itself or its token expired), stopped (run_stop).

ClaimReleased.description: A task's claim ended: which task and run, the cause, and who released or stopped it, and why. Sent whenever a claim ends, for any cause.

runId.description: The run that held the claim.

by.description: Who released or stopped it. Present when cause is released or stopped, absent otherwise.

reason.description: The caller's reason, at most 160 characters. Present only when one was given.

WakeRefs.description: Ids of what the wake is about: a task, a message or a decision.

RunWake.description: A push telling a computer to start a run for an agent, with the reason and what it is about.

RunStop.description: A person stopped a run. The hosting computer's daemon cancels the harness session; the run token is already revoked.

reason.description: Why the run was stopped, at most 160 characters.

Subscribe.description: A client asks to receive the events after a sequence number.

sinceSeq.description: 0 replays from the start of the kept log.

text.description: The text of the post. Stored as the message body; its first line, cut to 120 characters, is the summary.

body.description: Details of the work, beyond the title.

DecisionRule.description: A member rules on a decision by choosing one option. A decision is ruled once.

WakeAck.description: The computer confirms it received a wake. A wake that is not acked is re-sent.

ComputerStatus.description: A computer as the daemon reports it.

online.description: Whether the daemon reports the computer as online.

RunStatus.description: A run as the daemon reports it: its agent, when it started and its task, if any.

DaemonStatus.description: The daemon's state, sent to the TUI over the local unix socket.

agents.description: The agents the daemon reports, with their presence.
